cards.text: This environment's terraform-backend-git sidecar cannot serve LOCK: it answers 500 with `user: unknown userid 1000`, because its image has no /etc/passwd entry for the uid it runs as. No terraform apply can complete against it from this pod (the deploy CLI included). Fix belongs in the KubeCoder sidecar image.

{'text': "The mounted ~/.kube/config-prd-write is `kubecoder-rw`, a namespaced-edit identity with no cluster-scoped verb at all — it cannot get/list/patch PVs or create namespaces on prd. docs/live-infra-access.md documents this only for the `nodes` resource ('the mounted kubeconfigs have no rights on the cluster-scoped nodes resource'); the limit is in fact every cluster-scoped resource. Worth generalising that sentence so the next slice does not plan a proof around a write path that cannot do the job."}

{'text': "Slice 009's `tf-presync` ServiceAccount needs PV get/list/patch cluster-wide for the reattach to work; a run without it gets a 403 that fails the hook (verified behaviour, not speculation). Considered narrowing it with resourceNames, as this proof's throwaway SA did, but the real hook cannot enumerate volume names in advance."}

history.summary: ArgoCDTools is a working repo: a standard-library Python 3 `presync` package run as `python3 -m presync <repo> <revision> <stage> <namespace>` that requires GIT_USERNAME/GITHUB_TOKEN by name, clones the deploy repo at exactly the SHA it was handed through an inline credential helper, brings up terraform-backend-git (or attaches to one via PRESYNC_TF_BACKEND) and resolves argocd/<repo>/<stage>/terraform.tfstate into the three -backend-config flags init takes. Gate is .kubecoder/project.yaml with jenkins: IaC/ArgoCDTools — ruff check/format plus 22 unittest cases, green from the repo root; also exercised live from this pod against the environment's own backend on 6061, both the success and the failure paths.

P1's outcome is met: the four-argument contract matches design.md's Job skeleton and the ApplicationSet's clone-URL `hook.repo`, the clone is at exactly the SHA it was handed with `rev-parse` re-asserting it, and the backend URL and its three `-backend-config` flags are `deploy_cli/tf.py`'s shape under the ruled `argocd/<repo>/<stage>/terraform.tfstate` key. No gate was recorded, so I ran it: `kc project lint` and `kc project test` are green (22 cases), and `python3 -m presync` exits 1 with a named cause. Three advisory findings, none blocking merge; F1 matters before the test phase runs the live proof, because this pod's ambient git credential helper shadows presync's and can make V02 check off falsely.

findings.summary: `git -c credential.helper=` appends to the chain, so this pod's ambient `store` helper answers the clone instead of GITHUB_TOKEN — harmless in the image, but it makes any from-this-pod proof of V02's inline-helper authentication false-green.

`provide()` starts terraform-backend-git and probes the port without requiring the daemon's own environment (SOPS_AGE_KEY, TF_BACKEND_HTTP_ENCRYPTION_PROVIDER, TF_BACKEND_HTTP_SOPS_AGE_RECIPIENTS), so a Secret missing them fails inside a state request rather than by name; these three sit on the P1/P2 seam.

tests/test_cli.py:74's `run_dir` emptiness assertion is true by construction because `tempfile.mkdtemp` is unpatched in that test; mutation-confirmed — moving the clone ahead of the credential checks leaves all 22 tests green.

The run found a fatal defect the test double was hiding: the estate's cluster CA carries no keyUsage extension and Python 3.13 enables VERIFY_X509_STRICT by default, so the reattach could not open a connection to prd at all; `Api` now clears that one flag (chain, expiry and hostname verification stay on, unknown CAs still refused) and the double was reshaped into a keyUsage-less CA signing a separate leaf, mutation-confirmed to fail without the fix. The VERIFY_X509_STRICT relaxation is load-bearing and mutation-confirmed (removing it fails 8 of 52 tests on the gate's Python 3.13), and the apply-then-reattach order is safe against what the estate's Terraform actually declares.
